description: The GWAS Catalog's controlled BROAD ANCESTRAL CATEGORY vocabulary. pipeline/report_lib/ancestry.py parses the catalog's category cell by longest match against these labels and fails the run on any residue, so an unrecognised category cannot silently vanish from a denominator.
source: Ancestry categories as published in the GWAS Catalog ancestry download and defined by the framework the catalog adopted: Morales et al., 'A standardized framework for representation of ancestry data in genomics studies', Genome Biology 2018, 19:21 (https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-018-1396-2).
parsing_note: The catalog separates several categories within one cell by a comma and a space. The cell must NOT be split on a comma, because the Greater Middle Eastern label carries two commas of its own; longest match against this list is the rule instead. Labels are listed in report order and matched case-sensitively, exactly as the catalog writes them.
order_note: Report order groups the labels by the continental grouping the framework uses, then places the unspecified, other and not-reported labels last. The order is presentation only and no computation depends on it.

categories.label: Greater Middle Eastern (Middle Eastern, North African or Persian)
